task: Prevent elapsed-time-only restarts of long-running host-native reviewers and workers.
outcome: When a reviewer or worker runs longer than ten minutes, Proof-or-Stop reports that it is still running or in the background and continues monitoring it. It starts a replacement only after the host reports a conclusive failed, cancelled, or missing task state.
facts: Current Claude transcript contains foreground agent completions after 75, 86, and 98 minutes.
Current Claude transcript contains background reviewer completions after approximately 15, 31, and 47 minutes.
Existing generated guidance in story-dispatch.ts and transition-effects.ts says ten minutes without a result may be treated as stalled and restarted.
story-create.ts and core/machine.ts contain an even more aggressive four-minute restart recommendation.
Explicit subprocess deadlines such as cross_host_review are separate fail-closed mechanisms and remain in scope only as an excluded boundary.
constraints: Do not restart solely from elapsed wall time.
Prefer authoritative host-native task status when the host exposes it.
Continue monitoring running/background tasks and do not duplicate when status is unknown.
Only conclusive terminal evidence authorizes a replacement.
Preserve explicit bounded subprocess timeout enforcement.
Do not edit story storage or fixtures directly.
